name: Adelshof
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Adelshof in Tirol – a charming retreat in the heart of the Alps!
beschreibung: The Adelshof in Innsbruck is a popular restaurant that delights its guests with a diverse menu and authentic regional hospitality. The ambiance blends traditional Tyrolean charm with modern comfort, creating a welcoming atmosphere for any occasion. The menu features carefully selected dishes—from classic Tyrolean specialties like Tiroler Gröstl and Kaiserschmarrn to international favorites. The team places special emphasis on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients from the surrounding area. Whether you're enjoying a cozy dinner for two, celebrating with family, or hosting a business meeting, the Adelshof warmly welcomes you and ensures a memorable stay with its attentive service.
